title: Input variable index
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits and $m$ gates, index the variables by the disjoint union of one constant variable, the $n$ input variables, and the $m$ gate variables. The variable corresponding to input bit $i$ has index $i+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and a finite number of gates
An input index $i$ among the $n$ input bits
